task.behavior: Arrange redraws the connections it moves, the outline holds a hundred components without scrolling sideways, and the repository ships mapgrain 0.2.3 with a README whose images come from that build.
acceptance: After Arrange every caption sits on the connection it belongs to, not where the previous layout left it.
The outline never scrolls sideways, at any pane width, with a hundred components loaded.
Components and connections are separate folding sections, so either is reachable without scrolling past the other.
A connection row truncates whichever end is longer rather than always hiding the target.
The canvas selection readout does not sit under the pane controls at narrow widths.
mapgrain 0.2.3 is published, and every current instruction in the README, the skill and the docs names it.
The README media is captured from this build.
